integrity: A full analytic proof and a standalone exact-rational plus finite-difference cross-check are included; numerical checks supplement, not replace, the global proof. No independent audit or independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Instantaneous resets; ideal reflected Brownian generator and step-rate activation; asymptotic event counts only; no finite-window, actuator-cost, or drift generalization. An earlier general first-reset framework may implicitly subsume the evaluated clock formula, so independent novelty verification remains outstanding.
title: A sharp sub-Poisson to super-Poisson transition in asymmetric Brownian reset counts
